cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_dir=/srv/inventory/data
source_parent=/srv/inventory
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory

if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
    printf 'inventory backup: source directory is missing: %s\n' "$source_dir" >&2
    exit 1
fi

install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "$backup_dir"
umask 077
exec 9>"$backup_dir/.inventory-backup.lock"
if ! flock -n 9; then
    printf 'inventory backup: another backup is already running\n' >&2
    exit 75
fi

timestamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%NZ)
archive="$backup_dir/inventory-$timestamp.tar.gz"
temporary=$(mktemp "$backup_dir/.inventory-$timestamp.tmp.XXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$temporary"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

tar --acls --xattrs --selinux --numeric-owner -C "$source_parent" -czf "$temporary" data
tar -tzf "$temporary" >/dev/null
mv -- "$temporary" "$archive"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -printf '%f\n' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -r \
    | sed -n '8,$p' \
    | while IFS= read -r old_archive; do
        if [ -n "$old_archive" ]; then
            rm -f -- "$backup_dir/$old_archive"
        fi
      done

printf 'inventory backup created: %s\n' "$archive"
